- **Original result (2013):** Galvin and Thanh showed that for forests with n vertices and c(n) components, the number of classes in a uniformly chosen partition into independent sets is asymptotically normal, provided c(n) = o(√(n/log n)) ([2-3]). - **Resolution (Galvin, 2016):** Galvin settled the conjecture in the affirmative. He extended it to graphs that are co-chromatic with a quasi-threshold graph and have negligible chromatic number ([8-5]).
